name: moBERTo
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from answerdotai/ModernBERT-base (config.json max_position_embeddings 8192). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder, alternating local (128) and global attention (every 3rd layer)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of answerdotai/ModernBERT-base, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.15 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-04-25. CAVEATS: Portuguese encoder. Reranking here means a cross-encoder scoring pass over a candidate set, not a bi-encoder retriever - the card's own numbers are nDCG@10 after reranking. Wins PLUE-PT and LeNER-Br but loses MLDR@2048 to moBERTo-orig-tokenizer (0.5606 vs 0.6025) and GLUE-English (0.7354 vs base 0.8301) because of the Portuguese tokenizer swap. Base is ModernBERT-base, params 0.15B.
